**Fab Shift Log Summary (98 words):**

- **Chamber Pressure:** Slight overnight drift in 3 chambers, within tolerance.
- **Defects:** Cracked focus ring in etcher 7 caused defects on wafer W-24-0917, lot held.
- **Maintenance:** CMP pad replaced on 3 polishers, probe cards cleaned on 3 tools, chemistry refreshed on 3 wet benches.
- **Performance:** Defect density near line average, etch uniformity showed usual edge roll-off, overlay within spec on 3 steppers.
- **Issues:** Brief vacuum alarms on 3 implanters, handler jams on 3 sorters (no wafer loss), metrology queue behind (max 38 minutes).
